coordinates.origin: location ground line at y = 0; +x screen-right, +y up
coordinates.angles: degrees; joint angles positive = forward/flexion (see engine contract)
coordinates.time: seconds within the shot; frames derived from production fps

style.fills: solid flat colour only; no gradients, textures, shadows or glow
style.transparency: opaque only, except assets that declare transparency
style.face: optional profile eye and simple mouth; no nose, no ears

layering.rule: Components use z offsets relative to these body parts; back-side garments sit just above the back limb, front-side garments just above the front limb.

camera_conventions.screen_direction: Preserve left/right order of characters across cuts unless a shot declares an intentional change.

approval.rule: Locked/approved files may change only with a version bump recorded via `kage.py approve`; downstream shots are invalidated by content hash.
